ZH_selection: Frozen ZH cut-based optimum (final.json optimum): OSSF pair pT>15 with |mll-mZ|<25, mllgg>100, 2 photons pT>25 with pT1/mgg>1/3, pT2/mgg>0.25, no b-veto, no Zeppenfeld, mjj>500, |deta_jj|>3.5; the m_gg window is NOT applied: templates cover m_gg 105-165 GeV in 2 GeV bins, the +-2 sigma window (120.8-129.1 GeV) of the counting analysis lies inside. Backgrounds: corrected fake-photon rows (fake factor, D34/D37, kappa=0.956, closure systematics), all other rows identical to zh-final-v1.1.
window_definition: yield_window_500 = exact +-2 sigma_core window of the counting analysis: mu=124.975, sigma_core=2.067 -> 120.84-129.11 GeV (8.28 GeV wide); yield_bins_121_129_500 = sum of the 2 GeV bins with centres inside 121-129 (8 GeV wide), 3.4 percent smaller for flat shapes, e.g. fake1_qcd 0.00692 vs 0.0072
normalisation: events per 500 fb^-1 at 13.6 TeV, BR(H->gg) = 0.00227 and Z->ee,mumu applied once (k in the sample weights); luminosity scaling linear for events and MC errors
template_method: resonant rows (EW and QCD ZHjj, ggZH, ttH, tHW, ZH(tautau)): signal-shape histogram of the EW ZHjj sample (all cuts, no window) scaled to the row's window yield; continuum rows (Zgg, top, fake): row window yield / exponential window fraction x exponential bin integral (frozen method, unbinned MLE; weighted MLE for the fake-factor rows). Per-bin MC error err_bin = sqrt(nu_bin e^2/y) so that the sum in quadrature equals the total MC uncertainty of the row estimate (L0/L1/L2 hierarchy of the frozen code).

coupling.convention: Y_bin(kW,kZ) = alpha kW^2 + beta kW kZ + gamma kZ^2 (events/500 fb^-1, BR(H->gg) at SM inside k), times R_BR(kW,kZ) exactly as in wh/scripts/coup_run.py (|A_gg|^2 with A_W = -8.32 kW, A_t = +1.84, width sum BR_i kappa_i^2). Primary sign convention (D46): lambda = kW/kZ tested at kZ = -1 (kW = -lambda), kt = +1: the quadratic form is even under (kW,kZ) -> (-kW,-kZ), R_BR evaluated at the actual signs. Variant: sign on kW (kZ=+1). Sample points: HC_NLO_X0_kVV at kZ = 1 and lambda = -1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,1.5 (homogeneous degree 2: these determine alpha,beta,gamma exactly).

coupling.qcd_zhjj_scaling: H_QCD_ZHjj scales with kZ^2 (Higgsstrahlung type), as in the frozen coupling_section.py (def. b only); ggZH, ttH, tHW, ZH(tautau), Zgg, fake and top rows are NOT rescaled (limitation)

wh_signal_in_zh_sr.treatment: NOT a sample of the ZH channel (R3 fix 3): zero MC support (0 raw events of 300k in the ZH SR, all cuts, 105-165 GeV; 0-2 raw events at the CP-even coupling points), so any central value or per-bin MC error would be noise and the old placeholder (mcstat 3.2e-5/bin, 9.7e-4 events in total) exceeded the 95 % UL. Stated bound instead: events at 500 fb^-1 in the ZH SR, mu_WH-scaled, negligible against the ZH background of 0.47 events.
